| `SampleDoc.doc`                  | `document/SampleDoc.doc`                  | Word 97–2003                           |
| `SampleSS.xlsx`                  | `spreadsheet/SampleSS.xlsx`               | Excel, OOXML                           |
| `SampleSS.xls`                   | `spreadsheet/SampleSS.xls`                | Excel 97–2003                          |
| `SampleShow.pptx`                | `slideshow/SampleShow.pptx`               | PowerPoint, OOXML                      |
| `SampleShow.ppt`                 | `slideshow/SampleShow.ppt`                | PowerPoint 97–2003                     |
| `bug53475-password-is-pass.docx` | `document/bug53475-password-is-pass.docx` | Encrypted Word; the password is `pass` |
